archetype: 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) - Adapted for Corporate Authority & Trust

typography.notes: Do not use 'Inter' for headings. Use 'Outfit' to impart a modern, premium corporate feel. Text tracking must be tight for headings.

spacing_and_layout.grid_strategy: MODE B: THE CONTROL ROOM GRID
spacing_and_layout.notes: Maintain strict optical alignment. Use generous padding inside containers. Avoid dense stacking without at least a gap-4 separator.

surfaces.headers: Solid background (bg-white) with a hard bottom border (border-b border-slate-200). Use sticky positioning with z-40.
surfaces.cards: Flat background (bg-white), 1px subtle border, very soft shadow (shadow-sm). On hover, do not add heavy shadows; instead, darken the border slightly if interactive.
surfaces.modals: Use glassmorphism for the overlay (bg-slate-900/40 backdrop-blur-sm). The modal itself should be solid white with a 1px border and a crisp shadow-xl.

components.strategy: Shadcn UI heavily customized to match the Swiss & High-Contrast archetype. Prioritize flat, rectangular forms over excessive roundness.
components.tables: Use Shadcn Table. Headers should have a light gray background (bg-slate-50). Rows must have hover states (hover:bg-slate-50/50) with border-b. Text in tables must be slightly smaller (text-sm) for density.
components.forms: Use Shadcn Form, Input, Select. Inputs should have rounded-lg, border-slate-200, and focus:ring-primary focus:border-primary. Do not use native HTML selects.
components.charts: Use Recharts or Shadcn Charts. Limit chart colors to the primary blue palette and neutral slates to maintain the corporate feel.
components.buttons: Primary: Solid Blue (bg-blue-700 text-white hover:bg-blue-800). Secondary: Outline (border-slate-300 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50). Radii should be rounded-lg.
components.badges: Use rounded-md, flat background, and high contrast text for status indicators.

motion.hover: Subtle transitions on borders and backgrounds (transition-colors duration-200).
motion.page_load: Staggered fade-in for list items and grid cards using Framer Motion or pure CSS keyframes.
motion.interaction: No bouncy animations. Use crisp, ease-out transitions for dropdowns and dialogs.

icons.style: Stroke width 1.5 for a clean, professional look. Size typically 18px or 20px.
icons.usage: Use consistently across the sidebar, table actions, and metric cards.

login_hero.description: Modern office building exterior at dusk. Use for the login page background or split-screen auth side.

avatars.description: Professional female avatar in blue dress.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text, especially on badges and primary buttons, meets WCAG AA 4.5:1 ratio against backgrounds.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have a visible focus state (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-300 focus:outline-none).
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute formatted as kebab-case based on role.

instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize a clean, minimal, premium dashboard look with a white/light gray background and high-trust Blue as the primary color.
Implement Role-Based Access Control logic efficiently, keeping the sidebar items reactive to the user's role.
Use Shadcn UI components extensively for Tables, Modals, Forms, and Dropdowns. Do not write complex interactive UI elements from scratch.
Maintain strict border colors (border-slate-200) and card backgrounds (bg-white) to emulate a premium, 'Control Room' Swiss layout.
Ensure 'Outfit' font is applied strictly to headings and 'IBM Plex Sans' to body content. If unavailable via Google Fonts, fallback to system sans-serif but define them clearly in CSS.
In the Login screen, implement a split layout where the left/right side uses the login_hero image with an overlay, and the form remains on a clean white surface.
Apply `data-testid` attributes to all forms, buttons, table rows, and key navigational elements for robust testing.
